proof_body:
by
  intro ζ n hn h
  have hnorm : ‖ζ‖ = 1 := Complex.norm_eq_one_of_pow_eq_one h hn.ne'
  have h1 : (starRingEnd ℂ) ζ = ζ⁻¹ := (Complex.inv_eq_conj hnorm).symm
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  rw [h1]
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [pow_succ] at h
  exact (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h).symm
target_source: ∀ (ζ : ℂ) (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ζ ^ n = 1 → (starRingEnd ℂ) ζ = ζ⁻¹ ∧ (starRingEnd ℂ) ζ = ζ ^ (n - 1)
